mechanism: Bind TWO actual disjoint five-cell U patches in the input board to the congruent U pentomino B, using their full original boundary edges. Targets generalizing a valid partial two-copy arrangement to a full three-copy partition, despite the visibly non-U leftover cells. This is a genuinely new local-to-global correspondence with a different part and two placements; previous X mapping is retained unchanged.
mathematical_solution: The 4x4-minus-one-corner board has 15 cells, so three congruent pentominoes are needed. Mathematical_enumeration.json enumerates all eight square-grid isometries, every placement, and every disjoint triple: A has2 tilings; B,C,D,E have0. The colored two U patches do occupy10 disjoint source cells, but their five-cell complement is disconnected and not another U. Other placements of B also have no complete triple. Thus A remains the unique answer. Existing grid edges receive color only; annotations do not force this partial partition or confer a condition that it extends.
human_gate: Only existing source-grid and B-grid unit edges receive 2pt red contour style; repeated shared edges have one action. Every cell boundary and the missing corner remain visible. The five unselected remaining cells can be read directly, preventing any new mathematical ambiguity; no grid cell or puzzle piece is added or removed.
